channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Border Patrol Boss Greg Bovino Has Left Chicago: Report
item.description: It’s unclear why Bovino suddenly returned to Chicago this week after departing the city in mid-November.

item.title: Humboldt Park Painter Wanted Chicagoans To Make More Art — So She Started Her Own Studio
item.description: At Mehal House, Eliza Karazah and her husband, Balpreet Singh, offer classes in sketching, foil embossing and other art, along with chai and samosas. They’re hosting a free open house Sunday.

item.title: Proposal Possibly Restricting ICE Expansion In Broadview Struck Down By Village Zoning Board
item.description: Residents don't know if the canned proposal would've helped or hindered ICE from a possible expansion into a nearby warehouse.

item.title: City Council Passes Alternative Revenue Measure, Setting Up Final Budget Vote Saturday
item.description: Defying Mayor Brandon Johnson, alderpeople voted 29-19 in favor of the alternative proposal, which includes a series of new fees and taxes instead of a head tax. The mayor on Friday said he has not yet decided if he will issue a veto.

item.title: City Beefs Up Police Presence At CTA Stations, But Feds Still Threaten To Withhold $50 Million
item.description: The CTA met a federal deadline to boost security, but the Trump administration called the plan “materially deficient,” giving the agency another 90 days to add more muscle or lose millions.

item.title: City Council Passes 2026 Budget: Here Are The Major Fees And Changes
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson could still veto the alternative spending plan, which includes a shopping bag tax increase, a new retail liquor fee and a small property tax hike to help fund the public library system.

item.title: West Side Teens Charged With Serious Crimes Can Now Avoid Jail In New School-Focused Program
item.description: Instead of being jailed while awaiting trial, West Side teens can enter a new pilot program that keeps them in school and in intensive after-school social services.

item.title: 7 Children Charged In Attack On Mom, 9-Year-Old Son Outside Far South Side School, Police Say
item.description: Children aged 10-13 were charged in the attack outside an elementary school, video of which went viral and shocked neighbors. The children are facing misdemeanor charges and have been assigned counseling services.

item.title: Forget A White Christmas. Chicago Could Have Among Its Warmest Christmas Days Ever
item.description: Christmas Day in Chicago will have highs in the 50s and light rain, which could make it one of the top 10 warmest Christmases in recorded history.

item.title: Chicago Man From Bulgaria Dies In ICE Custody After Immigration Arrest
item.description: Nenko Stanev Gantchev, 56, died in an ICE detention center in Michigan Dec. 15 after being arrested locally in September. Gantchev lived in the Chicago area for 30 years and was a business owner, according to reports.
